answer: The vine panel is drawn blind, the ferrous escrow settles at close, and quill lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. Jurors stake 10% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 251 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
